title: Cinnamon Roll Overnight Oats (Blended)
description: The ideal autumnal breakfast that takes 5 minutes to make. Creamy, cinnamon roll batter that has 12g of protein and all the cozy flavours.

hero.alt: Blended cinnamon roll overnight oats in a jar with a white chocolate swirl on top and oats scattered around

thumbnail.alt: Blended cinnamon roll overnight oats in a jar with a gold spoon and cinnamon swirl topping

instructions.text: Add all of the ingredients to a high power blender.
Blend until the oats are completely smooth.
Add in a few extra tablespoons of milk if you prefer a runnier texture and blend again.
Transfer to an airtight container and place in the fridge overnight.

notes: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.
If they thicken overnight, stir in a splash of milk before serving.
Add protein powder and blend for a high protein version — extra milk may be needed.

story.subtitle: smooth, dreamy 5-minute meal prep breakfast
paragraphs: if you love the cozy flavours of a cinnamon roll but want something you can actually eat for breakfast every single day with minimal effort, these blended cinnamon roll overnight oats are about to become your new bestie. the taste and texture is essentially like eating cinnamon roll batter for breakfast which tbh is the dream. they have all the warm, spiced sweetness you get from a cinnamon roll but they are refined sugar free, have 12g of protein with no protein powder and take just five minutes to prep the night before. making them perfect for those mornings where you need breakfast sorted before you've even woken up lol.

let's talk cinnamon for a second. the type of cinnamon you use actually matters more than you would think. there are 2 types of cinnamon: ceylon or cassia. cassia is easier to find in most supermarkets but from a nutritional stand point it is no match against ceylon cinnamon. there is a compound in cinnamon (called coumarin) and it has surprisingly been found to have toxic effects in humans if you consume it frequently. this compound is 250 times higher in cassia vs ceylon cinnamon. so opt for ceylon cinnamon if you are going to be using it a lot this autumn season. toxic side apart lol, there are so many benefits of cinnamon that can range from blood sugar regulation, high antioxidant count, to strong anti-inflammatory and anti-microbial properties.

onto the oats which are competing with the cinnamon for the main ingredient in this recipe. oats are rich in beta-glucan, a type of soluble fibre that supports heart health, helps regulate blood sugar levels, and keeps you feeling full. so paired with the cinnamon there are a whole host of benefits secretly hiding in these blended cinnamon roll overnight oats.

the dates add a gentle natural sweetness and are also packed with fibre, iron, and potassium. they blend completely smooth so you'd never know they're in there. i have opted for 2 kinds of sweeteners in this recipe: the dates and the maple syrup and they both play different roles. although both are adding sweetness to these blended cinnamon roll overnight oats, the dates are providing a richer flavour profile. they bring that caramel brown sugar richness that makes these overnight oats taste as close to the real deal as possible. then the maple syrup is really there just to provide sweetness which is why there is range depending on ur preference, you can just do 1 tablespoon or more, taste as you go!

if you've ever tried traditional overnight oats and found the texture too thick, too chewy, or just not your thing, this version completely solves that. blending the oats transforms the whole texture. it becomes smooth, creamy, and spoonable just like raw cake batter. taste wise it is somewhere between a pudding and the flavour of the center of a cinnamon roll which we all know is the best part.

i don't mind the chewy aspect of overnight oats when they are not blended, but it feels so much more indulgent when they are blended. it doesn't actually feel like an extra step since we just put all the ingredients straight into the blender and then transfer to a jar. and after that, the fridge does the rest of the work for us.

to serve you can just take these right out of the fridge and enjoy or leave them to warm up at room temp for a little bit. sometimes you will find that the oats have thickened even more overnight so just add in a splash of your fave milk or even a little boiling water if you want them a touch less cold until you reach your desired texture. since this is a single serve recipe you would want to increase the recipe to the amount of portions you would like to meal prep and just leave them in the fridge until you want to devour them. this is one of those recipes you can prep on sunday evening and have four days of easy breakfasts ready to go.
for the topping, i did do a cute lil swirl with white chocolate, this is optional it just looked nicer to film lol but coconut butter or your preferred yogurt work too!
if you love a blended overnight oat recipe, you have to try my carrot cake overnight oats or my blueberry muffin pancake bowl if you want something fresh from the oven and also meal preppable!

faq.question: How do I store blended cinnamon roll overnight oats?
faq.answer: Store in an airtight jar or container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days, making these perfect for weekly meal prep. If the oats thicken overnight (which is totally normal), just stir in a splash of your milk of choice before eating to loosen the texture back up.

faq.question: What type of oats should I use?
faq.answer: Rolled oats or porridge oats work best for blended overnight oats as they blend smoothly and absorb milk well overnight. Steel cut oats are not ideal for this recipe because they remain too firm and don't blend to the same creamy consistency.

faq.question: Are blended cinnamon roll overnight oats gluten free?
faq.answer: Oats are naturally gluten free, but cross-contamination can occur during processing if the oats aren't certified gluten free. If you need this recipe to be strictly gluten free, such as for coeliac disease, make sure to use a certified gluten free oat brand.

faq.question: Can I make high protein overnight oats?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a great recipe for adding protein powder. Add your favourite vanilla or unflavoured protein powder to the blender with the other ingredients. You'll likely need to add a little extra milk depending on how absorbent your protein powder is, as it can thicken the oats significantly.

faq.question: Why are these overnight oats blended?
faq.answer: Blending overnight oats creates a completely smooth, pudding like texture that's very different from the typical thick, chewy consistency of regular overnight oats. It makes the flavours more uniform throughout and gives the whole thing a much creamier feel. It's the version i always come back to if you've never loved the texture of traditional overnight oats.

faq.question: What topping works best with cinnamon roll overnight oats?
faq.answer: I used white chocolate for a subtle extra sweetness and that cinnamon roll aesthetic. Greek or coconut yogurt swirled on top is also a great option and adds extra protein. A dusting of cinnamon and a drizzle of maple syrup always works too. Keep it simple or dress it up, both ways are delicious.

faq.question: Can I eat these overnight oats warm?
faq.answer: Yes! If you prefer a warm breakfast, you can transfer the oats to a saucepan and gently heat them on the stovetop with a splash of extra milk, stirring as you go. Alternatively, microwave them in a microwave-safe jar for about 60 to 90 seconds, stirring halfway through. They're cozy and delicious warm too.

faq.question: My dates aren't soft, can I still make this recipe?
faq.answer: These blended cinnamon roll overnight oats call for soft medjool dates, but if your dates are harder just soak them in hot water for at least 10-15 minutes, then remove the water and throw them in the blender with the rest of the ingredients.

tips: Add your favourite protein powder to the blender for a high protein version. You may need extra milk depending on the absorbency of your powder.
Make up to 4 servings at once by multiplying all ingredients. Store each portion in its own jar for grab-and-go breakfasts throughout the week.
Use soft medjool dates for the best taste and texture.

alternatives: Omit and increase maple syrup to 2-3 tbsp
